items.title: SEC Crypto Custody Rewrite Enters White House Review
items.summary: The planned rule would cover advisers and investment companies and clarify digital-asset custody, following the withdrawal of a separate 2023 proposal.

items.title: SoFi Links Banking Network and Stablecoin to Kraken in New Deal
items.summary: Kraken will list SoFiUSD and gain access to SoFi’s round-the-clock dollar settlement network, while Kraken Prime will execute trades for SoFi’s crypto customers.

items.title: Australia is cracking down on crypto businesses as its strict new regulatory deadline nears
